linear.text: What was made and why: Pt counter electrodes perform poorly in polysulfid -> Wrapping hierarchical Cu2S microspheres with RGO s -> Cu2S microspheres from solvothermal CuCl, thiourea -> One-pot solvothermal reaction at 150 C for 12 h gr
Open the panels F1a, F1b, F1c, F1d [SEM] and rank (compare across conditions)
Observation: Insets: bare spheres show few large flakes; GO-containing spheres consist of many smaller, thinner flakes, finest in c-d
Claim it establishes: GO addition turns Cu2S into flower-like hierarchical microspheres built from more, smaller, thinner nanoflakes
Feeds: RGO-Cu2S-2 adsorbs more N2 than bare Cu2S: more accessible surface and more mesopore volume at 3-15
